fields.description: Save a copy of each run's transcripts and coverage report here.
fields.label: Output folder

setup_guide.introduction: I'll turn your recordings into Markdown transcripts and prepare a playback report. The report highlights words when their timing is verified. Choose an audio folder or try the included 50-minute recording. Processing requires NVIDIA Blackwell; the default profile needs 96 GiB GPU memory.

sample.expected_output: Complete Markdown, provenance and a playback report with word highlights where timing is verified.

starter_questions: How do I transcribe a folder?
Can I try the included recording?
